name: Binary-Pattern Description of Majority Closure
statement: $\operatorname{med}(C)$ consists exactly of the binary words whose restriction to every coordinate set of size at most two occurs in the corresponding projection of $C$.
proof: Every binary class on at most two coordinates is majority closed. Conversely, a minimally missing pattern of a majority-closed class cannot involve three coordinates: majoritying three witnesses, each omitting one selected coordinate, would realize it.
